init.title: Local connection options
init.description: UDP discovery tries unicast, broadcast and multicast. Use 0.0.0.0 to select the local interface automatically, or an IPv4 address belonging to Home Assistant. The broadcast address defaults to 255.255.255.255; you may enter your subnet broadcast address or leave it empty to disable broadcast.
